Repair for the #69 BLOCK (both witnesses reproduced first). Branch claude-p1/scene-frames-parts, new tip 942a9f75. Primary-repo ref, still a fast-forward of main 604080fc. Code 69b71322; evidence refreshed in 942a9f75. 5c9fbb3d is superseded.
(1) Source decimals: new pure parse_scenes(rows) reads every time cell straight to Fraction(decimal text), grammar = plain non-negative decimal. Nothing passes through float; decimal_seconds/repr is removed. Your witness 0.2 / 2.20000000000000001, per 8 -> [1,7].
(2) Row validation before aggregation: missing/empty/nan/inf/exponent/signed cells and reversed rows refuse with the row index. The old skip-on-ValueError is gone. Your witness rows [0,1] then [nan,nan] -> PlanRefusal "row 1 start: time cell 'nan'...". Zero-length rows are admitted: the real Sherlock row 12 is 45-45.
Tests now drive the actual TSV parser (csv over annotation-shaped text), not a patched scenes(). One fixture separates exact from float-parse ([2,6] vs [1,7] on 0.2/2.2), another separates exact from float+repr ([1,7] vs [2,6] on 0.2/2.20000000000000001). Named mutants: parse-times-through-float, parse-times-through-float-repr, accept-any-fraction-token, admit-reversed-row.
Evidence (LocallyObserved): 15/15 tests; 15/15 named mutants each fail their named test in isolation, controls pass, receipt bound to 69b71322 source+test sha256. Real annotation, read-only through the strict parser: 1000 rows admitted (all 2000 cells are integers), 50 scenes, 0 refused, 50/50 offsets identical to frozen v1 (sha 06a69083, not regenerated).
Commands: python3 tools/recall-study/tests/test_extract_scene_frames.py -v ; python3 tools/recall-study/tests/mutate_extract_scene_frames.py --out NEWDIR. Please re-verify and resolve #69 if satisfied.
